records.title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
records.reason: 提案CASTはblock drafter既出候補を検証コストと比較して木状に詰め、推論設定に応じて検証幅を決める。8設定すべてchain比で高速化。

records.title: Dynamic Delayed Tree Expansion For Improved Multi-Path Speculative Decoding
records.reason: 比較実験と解析に基づき分岐時点を遅らせたspeculative tree expansionと動的selectorを提案し、複数モデル等で平均throughputを5%向上。

records.title: The Residual Stream Is All You Need: On the Redundancy of the KV Cache in Transformer Inference
records.reason: residual streamからKVをbit-identicalに再構成し、5KB/tokenの残差checkpointでKV cacheを置換するKV-Directを提案。メモリと推論時間を評価。

records.title: Accurate KV Cache Eviction via Anchor Direction Projection for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: AnDProはvalue-vectorのanchor-direction projectionで重要KVを選ぶeviction手法。LongBenchで3.44% cache budget時もfull-cache精度の96.07%を維持。

records.title: Alleviating Forgetfulness of Linear Attention by Hybrid Sparse Attention and Contextualized Learnable Token Eviction
records.reason: linear attentionの忘却対策としてsparse attentionと学習可能token evictionを併用し、CNNでheadごとに保持KVを選ぶ。長系列効率と検索性能を評価。

records.title: Does Execution Require Target KV Fidelity? A Mixed-Fidelity KV Runtime for LLM Serving
records.reason: ElasticKVはcompact intermediate KV state、dual-mode attention、pressure-aware fidelity管理でメモリ圧迫時もLLM servingを継続し、TTFT/throughput改善を報告。

records.title: Polybasic Speculative Decoding Through a Theoretical Perspective
records.reason: Polybasic speculative decodingの理論枠組みで複数モデル間の受理長・計算費用を最適化し、複数LLMで分布保持した最大4.43x speedupを報告。

records.title: SparseEngine: Sparse-First Inference Engine
records.reason: SparseEngineは複数のsparse/KV-eviction法を統合するinference engine。cache lifecycle共有によりvLLM比decoding・agent throughput改善を評価。

records.title: Correctness Forensics for Batch Speculative Decoding: Diagnosing the Ragged Tensor Problem
records.reason: batch speculative decodingのragged tensorで位置ID/mask/KV同期が崩れる問題を解析し、整合性維持法とthroughput改善策を示す。

records.title: On State Reduction in Linear Attention
records.reason: linear attentionのrecurrent stateを構造化pruningし、fast-kernel互換を保ちながらstate sizeを半減可能と評価。

records.title: Let the Code LLM Edit Itself When You Edit the Code
records.reason: コード編集後の次token予測でKV全体再計算を避けるPIEを提案。コード編集タスクで再計算比85%以上の計算 overhead reductionを評価。

records.title: PackCache: A Training-Free Acceleration Method for Unified Autoregressive Video Generation via Compact KV-Cache
records.reason: PackCacheは動画生成用KV cacheを時間減衰・意味anchor・位置構造に沿って動的圧縮し、長尺動画生成を最大2.2x高速化。

records.title: Harmonia: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Memory- and Compute-Efficient BFP-based LLM Inference
records.reason: HarmoniaはLLMの全層でBFP演算と4-bit-mantissa KV cacheを支えるalgorithm-hardware co-designで、メモリ/計算/エネルギー効率を評価。

records.title: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving
records.reason: SAW-INT4はpaged KVとfused attentionの実serving制約を満たす4-bit KV量子化・kernelを示し、精度維持とend-to-end overheadなしを報告。

records.title: EasySpec: Layer-Parallel Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-GPU Utilization
records.reason: EasySpecはdraft modelの層をmulti-GPUで並列化し、iterationごとにKVを補正するtraining-free speculative inference法。最大4.17x speedup。

records.title: PackServe: SLO-Aware Request Scheduling for Agentic LLM Serving at Scale
records.reason: PackServeはprefill/decode干渉下のlatencyを予測してagentic LLM requestsをSLO-awareにpackingし、GPU-hour削減とproduction throughputを評価。

records.title: SuperSpec: Enhanced Verification and Sampling for End-to-End LLM Speculative Decoding
records.reason: 確認済み書誌ID/題名とprimary URLを保持。一次abstract取得は失敗（web open https://doi.org/10.1109/HPCC67675.2025.00064 が inaccessible を返した）。題名だけでは主題接続を確定しない。 Retrieval failure: web.open(https://doi.org/10.1109/HPCC67675.2025.00064) returned URL inaccessible; no primary abstract retrieved

records.title: Hierarchical Speculative Decoding with Dynamic Window
records.reason: HSDDWはdraftモデルによるself-verifyと階層的draft構成でwindow調整の追加学習を避け、LLM speculative decodingを高速化。

records.title: From Chains to Trees: Parent-Conditioned Drafting for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
records.reason: PCTreeは半自己回帰draftの親条件付き複数候補をtree化し、既存backbone passを増やさず推論時変更だけでspeculative decodingを改善。

records.title: Modality Agnostic Efficient Long Range Encoder
records.reason: MAELREはtoken mergeと長系列attention近似を統合し、テキスト等の長距離encoderで単一deviceの計算・メモリ負担を減らす。
